results.query: Quy tac retry POST payment la gi?
results.retrieved: EPISODE: For POST /payments, every retryable request MUST send the same Idempotency-Key. Retry only HTTP 429 or transient 5xx errors, use exponential-backoff, and stop after max-3-retries. Marker: PAYMENT-RULE-3.

results.query: Theo incident playbook, truoc khi tang timeout can kiem tra gi?
results.retrieved: EPISODE: When async HTTP calls time out, inspect connection pooling, downstream saturation and concurrency before increasing timeout. Reuse a long-lived client session where possible. Marker: CONN-POOL-FIRST.
